claims.head: A physical night ahead
claims.call: The two teams’ combined hit score reaches their usual 110.
claims.body: Boston’s hit score is 107 (10th of 32) and Anaheim’s is 112 (7th). 100 is league average, after adjusting for each arena’s scorer.

claims.head: Anaheim shoots from the point; Boston works down low
claims.body: On point-shot reliance, Anaheim sits 2nd of 32, at the point-heavy end of the scale. Boston is 26th, at the down low end.
claims.call: Anaheim takes a bigger share of its shots from the point than Boston.

notes.text: C. McAvoy has not played this season. M. Lohrei is in his usual spot beside J. Aspirot, up from third-pair minutes last season. That pair is getting 15:08 a game at 5-on-5, up from 12:59 with McAvoy. W. Borgen has moved into Lohrei’s old spot beside H. Lindholm.

ANA.head: Anaheim has a lot going for it
ANA.body: Anaheim has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Boston’s way back in is keeping the shots to the outside.

BOS.head: A tough matchup for Boston
BOS.body: Anaheim has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Boston’s best way through is keeping the shots to the outside.
